title: skills: teach the three permission axes — `viewAllFields` for "sees every field", field rows for role-dependent fields, `requiredPermissions` for high-sensitivity fields (step 2 of #34365)
body:
repo:objectstack#7 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibzFAE8YRsK8YCDAeLL

Filing gate: ④ sub-card of the ruled decision #34365 (ruling 6912661484, verbatim 「同意，立决策卡」; implementation cards are cut after PR #34082, merged 2026-11-16T21:40Z) · Source: topic #34365

Parent: #34365 (step 2; the `Skills-docs:` follow-up the `viewAllFields` PR owes)
Blocked-by: #36050
Grade: left to triage. Suggested **p2** (a step of the p2 security card #34365). Area: data. Type suggestion: Task.
Dedupe: `repo:objectstack-ai/objectstack is:issue viewAllFields` → 3 hits: #34365 (the parent), #33828 (closed), #6015 (triage seat post). No card covers this step.

## Business reason

The ruling (#34365) is that AI-authored apps should get the permission model right by construction: View All / Modify All widen records only (in v19), "this role sees every field" is `viewAllFields`, role-dependent fields are field rows, and high-sensitivity fields (salary, ID numbers) are gated on the field with `requiredPermissions`, not hidden only by a permission-set row. If the authoring skills keep teaching View All as "see everything", every new app is written against the old model and the v19 conversion has to undo it.

## What to build

- Update the shipped authoring skills under `skills/**` that teach permission sets and field security (the dev finds them with `grep -rln "viewAllRecords\|readable: false" skills/`), and the matching product docs page if one exists, to teach:
  - the three axes (object permission · record scope · fields), in the words of #34365's "The model";
  - `viewAllFields` (read-only, own row beats it, on admin-like roles);
  - the sensitivity tiers: ordinary fields — write nothing; role-dependent — field rows; high-sensitivity — `requiredPermissions` on the field (+ `maskingRule` for a partial value);
  - that from v19 View All / Modify All no longer open fields (say "from v19", not "today").
- Evals for the taught shapes, as the skills lane requires.

## Constraints

- Governed surface (`skills/**`) ⇒ Tier H.
- Teach only what main enforces when this lands: build after the `viewAllFields` PR merges.

## Acceptance

- The skills teach the shapes above; the evals exercise `viewAllFields` and a `requiredPermissions`-gated field.
- Gates green; L1 + contract review PASS on the final head.
